Maple Grove Pump 02 cooling air, cold side: Dead channel on this pump. Sampled across the whole recorded window (2025-07-02 01:01 to 2025-07-11 23:59, 46 snapshots spread evenly over the ten days), this tag holds exactly 0 in every one of them - one distinct value. The same tag on the sibling pumps at this station varies normally over the same snapshots, and 64 of Pump 01's 87 numeric tags vary while only 13 of Pump 02's 85 ever leave zero; bay status reads Idle for every sampled snapshot on both. So this is not a pump that was merely stopped - a stopped pump still reports ambient temperatures, as Pump 01 does - it is instrumentation that reports nothing. The unit is therefore not settled by this pump's own data, and it cannot be inherited from the sibling that does report: a constant zero is equally consistent with degC, degF or an unwired input, and approving it would put a reading of "0 degC" on a machine page as though it were a measurement of a freezing machine. Withheld rather than approved for that reason, not for lack of a catalogue mapping - component and parameter are already assigned and are correct.
